subject: Mental Models
title: Transfer Across Domains
description: Learn Transfer Across Domains in one minute.

hook.text: A biologist discovered how ant colonies organize and then helped redesign delivery truck routes using the same logic.

buildup.text: Ants leave pheromone trails that strengthen when more ants follow. Shorter paths get stronger signals.

discovery.text: Transfer is carrying a model from one domain to a completely different one. The structure is the same; details change.

twist.text: Transfer rarely happens by accident. You must deliberately abstract the structure from the specific details.

climax.text: Practice spotting deep structures, not surface features. That skill unlocks transfer across any field.

punchline.text: Same structure, different skin. That is transfer.

quiz.question: What is required for knowledge to transfer across domains?
options: The domains must be closely related
You must abstract the underlying structure from specific details
